_note: This file contains only constant lists and sets of HTML tag names (UNWRAP_TAGS, structure, media, contain_interesting_attributes, MEDIA_CONTAIN_INTERESTING_ATTRIBUTES_SET, INTERESTING_TAGS_SET). There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs.
summarize_UNWRAP_TAGS: summarize the UNWRAP_TAGS list of inline HTML tags that modify rendered text style
summarize_structure_tags: summarize the structure list of HTML tags that contain text in a structured way
summarize_media_tags: summarize the media list of HTML tags targeting audio, video, and image elements
summarize_INTERESTING_TAGS_SET: summarize the INTERESTING_TAGS_SET containing all HTML tags kept during tree processing
summarize_MEDIA_CONTAIN_INTERESTING_ATTR: summarize the MEDIA_CONTAIN_INTERESTING_ATTRIBUTES_SET for media tags with useful attributes like src
